name: Tree Ornament
details: A beautiful and festive Tree Ornament 3D model, themed around nature and intricate decorative art style designs. The asset features detailed leaf motifs, intertwined branch patterns, and a glossy, reflective surface finish that responds beautifully to real-time environmental lighting. Designed with a balanced distribution of polygons, it achieves smooth rounded curves and clean cut-outs without stressing mobile hardware or causing rendering lag. This model is perfect for holiday visualization apps, virtual interior decoration planners, and modern product design showcases in augmented reality. Users can hang or place the ornament virtually in their room to inspect the design depth and reflective properties from any angle. It is fully optimized for the InfoScan application, delivering rapid streaming and highly stable performance.
